name: @carbon/three-fiber
description: Solid bridge for three.js — JSX intrinsics that map to three.js objects, rendered via @carbon/three.
//dependencies: @carbon/three is already declared as a peerDependency above, which is the correct relationship — this package bridges Solid to it rather than vendoring it. It was ALSO listed here as `workspace:*`, a bun-workspace specifier that V2 has no workspace to resolve. Internal @carbon/* wiring is tsconfig path aliases (.config/tsconfig.base.json), never a package-manager edge.
